scope: Terminology correction for immutable derived summary field names; original monitor bytes and all counts retained.

monitor_failed_flag.meaning: No structural monitor error flag; not a stopping success. passed=0 and consecutive=0/50.

hold_false_count.meaning: Count of stored hold_drift_pass=false. All36 below_thresholds=false so a hold anchor was unavailable; these are not36 measured drift-limit exceedances.

raw_zero_drift_fields: When below=false, C_drift/s_drift zeros are unavailable monitor anchors, not independently measured zero drift. Mark N/A in figures.
